{i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}

lines.en: scene sky
: Hey, Tsuneyo...
lines.zh: : 嘿，Tsuneyo……

lines.en: : That is the name I was given.
lines.zh: : 那是别人给我取的名字。

lines.en: : Ya ever wonder why we’re here?
lines.zh: : 你有没有想过我们为什么在这儿？

lines.en: : It’s one of life’s great mysteries, isn’t it? Why {i}are{/i} we here?
lines.zh: : 这可是人生最大的谜题之一，不是吗？我们究竟为何存{i}在{/i}于此？

lines.en: : Are we the product of some cosmic coincidence? Or is there really a god watching over everything?
lines.zh: : 我们是某种宇宙巧合的产物？还是真有一位神在注视着一切？

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach1
: ...Huh? No, like...why are we on the beach? Why don’t we ever go anywhere else? Aren’t there plenty’a places we could take the class to unwind for a weekend?
lines.zh: : ……哈？不是，我是说……我们为什么在海滩上？为什么从来不去别的地方？能带全班去度个周末的地方不是多的是吗？

lines.en: : Oh.
: The heck was all that stuff about God?
lines.zh: : 那你刚才扯那一大堆上帝的话是什么意思？

lines.en: : Likely one more allusion to a long-forgotten relic of the early 2000’s.
lines.zh: : 大概是又一次引用了某个早已被遗忘的 2000 年代初的老古董。

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach2
: The heck you know about the early 2000’s? Ain’t you-
lines.zh: : 你懂个屁的 2000 年代初？你不是——

lines.en: : Don’t say it. Someone will file a complaint.
lines.zh: : 别说了。会有人投诉的。

lines.en: : Yer’ bein’ weird as hell today. The sun doin’ this to you? Do we gotta head back inside already?
lines.zh: : 你今天怪得要死。是太阳晒的？咱们得回屋里去了吗？

lines.en: : All we’ll find inside is a separate sun. We are better off out here, where the larger one can make our bodies more desirable to the opposite sex.
lines.zh: : 屋里等着我们的不过是另一颗太阳。待在外面更好，至少这颗更大的太阳能让我们的身体对异性更有吸引力。

lines.en: : Uh-
: Or the same sex if you are Lebanese.
lines.zh: : 要是黎巴嫩人的话，那就是对同性。

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach3
: Is {i}that{/i} where you’re from? Always forget that ain’t everybody from Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 你是{i}那{/i}儿来的？我总忘了不是所有人都出身 Kumon-mi。

lines.en: : I was born here, just as you were. It is my mother who dared to venture outside the confines of this city.
lines.zh: : 我和你一样生在这里。是我母亲胆敢踏出了这座城市的边界。

lines.en: : But I suppose it would not technically count as {i}venturing{/i} as she was born in Egypt and did not travel there.
lines.zh: : 不过严格来说那也算不上「{i}踏出{/i}」，因为她生在埃及，并不是旅行过去的。

lines.en: : You ever gonna go over there? When the walls are all gone and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 你以后会去那边吗？等那些墙都消失之后什么的。

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach4
: Do you think they ever will be?
lines.zh: : 你觉得它们真会有消失的那天吗？

lines.en: : Do you not?
lines.zh: : 你不这么觉得？

lines.en: : Not in our lifetimes, I don’t imagine. There’s been no sign at all of them coming down — nor is there much of a reason for it if you really stop and think about it.
lines.zh: : 我想，在我们有生之年不会。完全没有它们会倒塌的迹象——而且你真要静下心来想想，也没什么理由让它们倒。

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach5
: For real?! Ya mean I’ll never get to see Brazil?!
lines.zh: : 真的假的？！你是说我这辈子都看不到巴西了？！

lines.en: : Nor will {i}I{/i} ever get to see Virginia. Such a shame. But there is simply nothing that can be done about it.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}也同样永远看不到 Virginia 了。真是遗憾。但此事终究无能为力。

lines.en: Tsuneyo Tojo masturbated for the first time last weekend. Or attempted to, at least.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo Tojo 上周末第一次自慰了。至少是尝试了一下。

lines.en: And while this is a strange time to inform you of such an occurrence, I can’t imagine any other that would make any more sense. And it will be relevant information going forward.
lines.zh: 虽然在这个时候告诉你这么一件事有点奇怪，但我想不出还有哪个时机更合适。而且这在接下来的内容里会是相关信息。

lines.en: You see, Tsuneyo Tojo, sheltered as she is, has been emerging from her shell ever since her first unintentional bout with exhibitionism. It’s something she had in common with the girl beside her.
lines.zh: 你看，Tsuneyo Tojo 虽然一直被养在深闺，但自从那次无心的暴露事件之后，她一直在破壳而出。这一点她跟身边的那个女孩是一样的。

lines.en: Granted, {i}that{/i} girl had never wandered out into the middle of the road in her birthday suit, chanting about apostates and what to do with them.
lines.zh: 当然，{i}那个{/i}女孩可从来没赤身裸体跑到马路中央，一边念叨着叛教者该怎么处置。

lines.en: And how could she? She didn’t even know what an “apostate” was. But that’s the only currently relevant information in regard to {i}her{/i} masturbatory habits (which have seen a recent incline).
lines.zh: 她又怎么会呢？她连「叛教者」是什么都不知道。不过关于{i}她{/i}的自慰习惯（最近有上升趋势），目前相关的只有这一点。

lines.en: For Tsuneyo, though, such a thing was confusing. But not in that pubescent sort of way where you’re still trying to figure out how your body works.
lines.zh: 但对 Tsuneyo 来说，这件事令人困惑。却不是那种青春期少女还在摸索自己身体构造的困惑。

lines.en: It was confusing for her because the same several figures kept appearing in her head. Her father, her teacher (former), and a man she saw planting a tree once.
lines.zh: 让她困惑的是，脑海里反复出现的始终是那几个身影。她的父亲、她的老师（前任），还有一次她看见一个在种树的男人。

lines.en: Thinking about her father in such context made her uncomfortable, so she shirked those feelings almost immediately. And the thoughts of the man with the tree were no more welcome.
lines.zh: 在这样的语境下想到父亲让她很不舒服，于是她几乎立刻就把那些念头压了下去。而那个种树男人的念头同样不受欢迎。

lines.en: Regardless, they would creep back into her mind at unwanted intervals as she imagined the impure things they’d do to her body.
lines.zh: 尽管如此，它们还是会在不合时宜的间隙爬回她的脑海，让她想象他们会对自己的身体做出那些不洁的事。

lines.en: As she clumsily fidgeted with her inexperienced bud, she found the most pleasure in recalling nights spent with her teacher. But even that was not enough to take her where she needed.
lines.zh: 她笨拙地拨弄着自己青涩的花苞，却发现最大的快感来自回忆与老师共度的夜晚。但即便如此，也不足以把她带到她需要去的地方。

lines.en: So after approximately seventeen minutes, she gave up on the endeavor and decided to keep such a thing secret for the foreseeable future.
lines.zh: 于是大约十七分钟之后，她放弃了这项尝试，并决定在可预见的将来对此守口如瓶。

lines.en: Which probably means I shouldn’t tell you. But again — relevant information. You still with me?
lines.zh: 这大概意味着我不该告诉你。但再说一次——相关信息。你还跟得上吗？

lines.en: Tsuneyo Tojo is something that we in the office call a “cottontail.” But no, not like the rabbit (despite how greatly you may wish to repeatedly breed her at this point in time).
lines.zh: Tsuneyo Tojo 是我们在办公室里称之为「棉尾兔」的存在。但不是，不是兔子那种（尽管到这一步你可能极其想让她反复受孕）。

lines.en: We call them cottontails strictly because girls like her are exceptional when it comes to avoiding predation, but somewhat lack in terms of mental capacity, often mistaking {i}what{/i} to avoid.
lines.zh: 我们叫她们棉尾兔，纯粹是因为像她这样的女孩在躲避捕食者方面天赋异禀，但在心智上略有欠缺，常常搞错该躲的究竟是{i}什么{/i}。

lines.en: Such girls are born when a greater power mates with a lesser one. And there are several others you may also be familiar with.
lines.zh: 这样的女孩诞生于更强大的存在与更弱小的存在交合之时。另外还有几个你大概也熟悉的例子。

lines.en: To anyone else, I’m sure they look like normal girls. But to me, a person experienced in dealing with them, they’re anything but. In fact, they’re really special.
lines.zh: 在别人眼里，她们肯定就是普通的女孩。但在我这个对付她们经验丰富的人看来，她们一点也不普通。事实上，她们非常特别。

lines.en: We can bottle their blood to cure cancer, but have been told we’re not allowed to do that since it messes with the circle of life.
lines.zh: 我们可以把她们的血装瓶来治愈癌症，但我们被告知不能这么做，因为那会扰乱生命之环。

lines.en: Additionally, they excrete a special fluid from the glands inside of their vaginae that makes sexual intercourse marginally more enjoyable for male partners.
lines.zh: 此外，她们阴道内的腺体会分泌一种特殊液体，让男性伴侣在性交时稍微更舒服一些。

lines.en: The last and most important factoid in regard to what makes the cottontail special is their relation to the seedbed. But you already know what that is-
lines.zh: 关于棉尾兔为何特别的最后也是最重要的一条小知识，是她们与「苗床」的关系。但你已经知道那是什么了——

lines.en: Wait, you don’t?
lines.zh: 等等，你不知道？

lines.en: Hm. Okay. That makes things a little more difficult. But I’ll try to break it down for you in the easiest way possible.
lines.zh: 嗯。好吧。这让事情稍微棘手了点。但我会尽量用最简单的方式给你讲明白。

lines.en: Each one of us has a number. Think of it like a rating that determines how closely related we are to “God.” So you can think of the seedbed as like...an airport lounge!
lines.zh: 我们每个人都有一个数字。你可以把它想成决定我们与「神」有多亲近的评分。所以你可以把苗床想成……一间机场贵宾休息室！

lines.en: It’s a lounge that only people with certain ratings can reach, and the cottontails are among that ilk.
lines.zh: 那是一间只有评分达到一定标准的人才能进入的休息室，而棉尾兔就属于那一类。

lines.en: Unfortunately, due to the nature of their existence, most of them are completely unaware that such lounges exist, electing to live out peaceful lives in fictional Japanese cities instead.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，由于她们存在的性质，她们中的大多数完全不知道这种休息室的存在，宁愿在虚构的日本城市里过平静的日子。

lines.en: So yeah! Basically, she’s special.
lines.zh: 所以就是这样！基本上，她很特别。

lines.en: {b}BUT SHE WILL NEVER KNOW HOW SPECIAL SHE IS UNLESS YOU FORCE-FEED HER THE INFORMATION REQUIRED TO PROGRESS BEYOND THE-{/b}
lines.zh: {b}但她永远不会知道自己有多特别，除非你把超越——所需的信息硬塞给她——{/b}

: By any chance, were you just sucked into a terrifying liminal space that bordered between “utterly incomprehensible” and “romantically mystifying?”
lines.zh: : 你该不会是刚刚被吸进了一个介于「完全无法理解」和「浪漫得神秘莫测」之间的恐怖阈限空间吧？

lines.en: : I ain’t really sure. I just started thinkin’ about whales a whole lot.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定。就是突然开始想鲸鱼想得特别多。

lines.en: : That happens to me sometimes as well.
lines.zh: : 我偶尔也会这样。

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach8
: Anyway, what were we talking about again? I can’t seem to remember.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，我们刚才在聊什么来着？我好像记不起来了。

lines.en: : Me neither. Maybe somethin’ about how there ain’t enough tan girls in our class and how everybody should go outside a little more?
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。大概是说我们班晒黑的女孩不够多，大家都该多出去走走？

lines.en: : If I become any darker, Miss Imai may mistake me for her daughter. And she already stares at me more than I am comfortable with.
lines.zh: : 我要是再黑一点，Imai 老师可能会把我认成她女儿。而且她盯着我看的时间已经超出我舒适的范围了。

lines.en: : Everybody stares at ya, Tsuneyo. You’ve got that cool “exotic” look to ya. I do it too and I don’t even like girls. Probably.
lines.zh: : 谁都盯着你看啊，Tsuneyo。你身上有种很酷的「异域」气质。我也盯着看，可我又不喜欢女生。大概吧。

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach9
: I’m not sure I enjoy being referred to as “exotic.”
lines.zh: : 我不太喜欢被称为「异域风情」。

lines.en: : Just meant ‘yer different from everybody else.
lines.zh: : 我就是想说你跟别人不一样。

lines.en: : I’m not sure that’s any better.
lines.zh: : 我不确定这就好到哪去了。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m diggin’ myself into a hole here, ain’t I?
lines.zh: : 是啊，我这是在给自己挖坑，对吧？

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach10
: It is fine. I know you mean no harm. You would not have invited me to bathe in sunlight with you if you harbored any ill-intent as I could kill you with just one hand.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我知道你没有恶意。如果你对我怀有歹意，就不会邀我一起晒太阳了——我只用一只手就能杀了你。

lines.en: : Yeah, exactly!
lines.zh: : 对，就是这个意思！

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach11
: But mostly, I just felt kinda weird bein’ in the room with Io and you were the closest person I could drag along that ain’t named Uta.
lines.zh: : 但主要是，跟 Io 待在一个房间里让我挺别扭的，而你是除了 Uta 之外我唯一能拽出来的人。

lines.en: : I was under the impression you and the green one were friends?
lines.zh: : 我还以为你和那个绿头发的姑娘是朋友呢？

lines.en: : I ain’t really sure, to be honest. Like, I thought so too! But she’s been all sorts’a unfriendly lately and I got no idea why. Maybe I said somethin’ weird?
lines.zh: : 说实话我也不确定。我本来也这么想的！可她最近各种不友好，我也不知道为什么。也许我说了什么怪话？

lines.en: : Did it involve apostates, by any chance?
lines.zh: : 该不会跟叛教者有关吧？

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach12
: A pasta? It ain’t noodle time again, is it?
lines.zh: : 意大利面？不会又到吃面的时间了吧？

lines.en: : It’s always noodle time.
lines.zh: : 什么时候都是吃面的时间。

scene mikutsuneyobeach14
{i}Further down the shore, a dark entity approaches.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}海岸更远处，一个漆黑的身影正在靠近。{/i}

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach15
{i}The dark entity is Rin.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那个漆黑的身影是 Rin。{/i}

lines.en: : Well, well, well — If it isn’t Otoha Okakura, my totally loyal ex-girlfriend who is definitely still respectful of me even though we are now broken up.
lines.zh: : 哎呀哎呀哎呀——这不是 Otoha Okakura 嘛，我那百分百忠诚的前女友，虽然我们早就分手了，但她肯定还对我毕恭毕敬。

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach16
: Huh? Wha-
scene mikutsuneyobeach17
: Oh. Hey, Rin. Sorry, you don’t normally sneak up on me like that. What’s up?
lines.zh: : 哦。嗨，Rin。抱歉，你平时不会这么突然冒出来。怎么了？

lines.en: : Should I redo my greeting? Were you not listening?
lines.zh: : 要我重新打招呼吗？你刚才没在听？

lines.en: : Sorry. My mind is kinda elsewhere right now.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我现在有点心不在焉。

lines.en: : Hey, that’s totally fine. I get it. Just let me know when the best time to confront you about you sending my nudes to other people is and I’ll come right back.
lines.zh: : 嘿，完全没关系。我懂。等你什么时候方便，我就来跟你对质——你把我的裸照发给别人这件事——到时候我再来找你。

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach18
: {i}Yeah.{/i} I know about that now.
lines.zh: : {i}对。{/i}这事我现在知道了。

lines.en: : Don’t worry. I’ve got all the time in the world for you to come up with an excuse now that I don’t have to spend an entire beach trip waiting for you to text me again.
lines.zh: : 别急。我有的是时间等你编好借口，反正我也不用再花整趟海滩之旅等你回消息了。

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach19
: Hah...
scene black
: You should probably sit down for this...
lines.zh: : 这件事你最好坐下来听……

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach20
: It’s going to be really hard to stay pissed off while we’re sitting on a banana boat, so be quick.
lines.zh: : 我们坐在这香蕉船上，我很难一直保持生气，所以长话短说。

lines.en: : Fine. If you want the quick version, I suck and I’m a terrible person who made a terrible decision because that’s all I ever do. And I apologize for being that way and betraying you.
lines.zh: : 好。你要简略版的话——我很烂，我是个糟糕的人，做了个糟糕的决定，因为我向来只会干这种事。我为自己的这副德性、为背叛了你而道歉。

lines.en: : Nevermind. That wasn’t satisfying enough. Give me the long version and I’ll just deal with the banana thing internally.
lines.zh: : 算了。这样不够解气。给我说详细版，香蕉船的事我自己忍着。

lines.en: : I mean...well...what do you {i}know{/i} already?
lines.zh: : 我是说……好吧……你已经{i}知道{/i}些什么了？

lines.en: : I know that Sensei has now seen my boobs twice and that neither of those times he has had permission to do that.
lines.zh: : 我知道 Sensei 已经看过我的胸两次了，而且这两次他都没有得到许可。

lines.en: : What the fuck happened the first time?
lines.zh: : 第一次到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach21
: Does that really matter right now?! How could you do this to me?! I trusted you!
lines.zh: : 现在说这个重要吗？！你怎么能这样对我？！我那么信任你！

lines.en: : I know! I know you trusted me! And I know how terrible what I did is, so just...tell me what to do and I’ll do it, okay?! I’m seriously, {i}seriously{/i} sorry!
lines.zh: : 我知道！我知道你信任我！我也知道自己干的事有多过分，所以……你说什么我就做什么，好吗？！我真的、{i}真的{/i}非常抱歉！

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach22
: Otoha, I don’t {i}want{/i} you to do anything. It’s hard enough just looking at you when, like...feelings still exist and stuff. {i}I just don’t get it.{/i} So I want to understand.
lines.zh: : Otoha，我并不{i}想要{/i}你做什么。光是看着你就已经够难受的了，因为……感情什么的还在。{i}我就是想不通。{/i}所以我想弄明白。

lines.en: : I get that we’re broken up now, but...it was amicable for the most part, wasn’t it? Do you seriously care so little for me that you’d just...put me out there like it’s nothing?
lines.zh: : 我知道我们已经分手了，但……总的来说还算和平分手，不是吗？你真的这么不在乎我，就这么……把我随随便便推出去？

lines.en: : Rin, I know it’s probably hard to believe, but I really {i}do{/i} care for you- okay? You were the first person I did {i}any{/i} of that stuff with. And you’ll {i}always{/i} be that person for me.
lines.zh: : Rin，我知道你可能很难相信，但我真的{i}在乎{/i}你——好吗？你是第一个和我做{i}那些{/i}事的人。而且你{i}永远{/i}都会是那个人。

lines.en: : Like, fifty years from now, I’m {i}still{/i} going to think about you when looking back on all of that. So this isn’t, like...me hating you or anything even {i}close{/i} to that.
lines.zh: : 就算五十年后，我回想起那一切的时候{i}还是会{/i}想到你。所以这不是……我恨你之类的，完全不{i}沾边{/i}。

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach23
: Then why?...
lines.zh: : 那为什么？……

lines.en: : What were you thinking?
lines.zh: : 你当时在想什么？

lines.en: : Otoha...I deserve to know. You’ve gotta give me that, at least.
lines.zh: : Otoha……我有权知道。至少这一点你得给我。

lines.en: : I {i}wasn’t{/i} thinking, okay? I was...horny.
lines.zh: : 我{i}什么都没{/i}想，好吗？我就是……发情了。

lines.en: : The fuck were you horny around Sensei for? You guys have literally never been like {i}that{/i} around each other.
lines.zh: : 你他妈对着 Sensei 发什么情？你们俩在一起的时候从来就不是{i}那种{/i}关系啊。

lines.en: : He...had something I wanted. So I kind of...you know...
lines.zh: : 他……有我想要的东西。所以我就……你懂的……

lines.en: : Gave {i}me{/i} up in exchange for it?...
lines.zh: : 拿{i}我{/i}去换那个东西？……

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach24
: Rin, I am {i}really{/i} sorry. Like, you can straight up just send all of {i}my{/i} nudes to him if it’ll make you feel any better. I deserve it.
lines.zh: : Rin，我{i}真的{/i}非常抱歉。你要是觉得好受点，直接把{i}我的{/i}裸照全发给他也行。我活该。

lines.en: : I can’t do that, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 我做不到，Otoha。

lines.en: : If it’s because of loyalty, you-
lines.zh: : 如果是因为义气，你——

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach25
: No, I mean I literally can’t. I deleted all of them in a fit of rage after we broke up.
lines.zh: : 不是，我是说真的做不到。分手的时候我一气之下把那些全删了。
: 哦……这样啊……

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach26
: But I wouldn’t have done that either way because it wouldn’t solve anything. Revenge isn’t going to help me {i}at all{/i} when I just want to {i}get it.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但不管怎样我都不会那么做，因为那解决不了任何问题。我只想{i}弄明白{/i}，报复对我{i}一点{/i}用都没有。

lines.en: : Rin-
lines.zh: : Rin——

lines.en: : What’d he have that you wanted so badly?...
lines.zh: : 他到底有什么东西让你那么想要？……

lines.en: : Who was it?...
scene mikutsuneyobeach27
: I...can’t tell you that. I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 我……不能告诉你。抱歉。

lines.en: : Do I know her?
lines.zh: : 我认识她吗？

lines.en: : I mean...yeah. Everyone knows her. But-
lines.zh: : 我是说……嗯。谁都认识她。但是——

lines.en: : Does she go to our school? Because I’ve spent a lot of time looking at boobs, Otoha. And those were boobs I didn’t recognize. But Sensei doesn’t talk to girls in other classes and I don’t know-
lines.zh: : 她在我们学校吗？因为我盯着胸看过不少，Otoha。可那对胸我没认出来。但 Sensei 又不跟别班的女生说话，我也不知道——

lines.en: : It’s just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: : Some girl I’ve had a crush on for a really long time. That’s all I can tell you.
lines.zh: : 一个我喜欢了很久的女孩。我只能告诉你这些。

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach28
: And...she’s never even considered me, so...I kind of jumped at the only opportunity I figured I’d ever have.
lines.zh: : 而且……她从来没正眼看过我，所以……我算是抓住了我以为唯一会有的机会。

lines.en: : How long?
lines.zh: : 多久了？

lines.en: : ...Long.
: While we were together?
lines.zh: : 我们在一起的时候就有了？

lines.en: : Since...{i}before{/i} we were together.
lines.zh: : 从……我们在一起{i}之前{/i}就开始了。

lines.en: : So I wasn’t the first girl you ever fell for.
lines.zh: : 所以我不是你第一个喜欢的女孩。

lines.en: : You were the first one I ever...{i}did{/i} stuff with.
lines.zh: : 但你是第一个和我{i}做{/i}那些事的人。

lines.en: : You told me you loved me, Otoha. Do you seriously think you can just...{i}do{/i} that while secretly pining for someone else?
lines.zh: : 你说过你爱我，Otoha。你真的觉得你可以一边{i}那么说{/i}，一边偷偷对别人朝思暮想？

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach29
: Rin, you did the same thing!
lines.zh: : Rin，你也一样啊！

lines.en: : I did not! I never even {i}considered{/i} being with anyone but you while we were together!
lines.zh: : 我没有！我们在一起的时候，我从没{i}想过{/i}要和你以外的人在一起！

lines.en: : You did, though! Even if you didn’t try to make anything happen!
lines.zh: : 你想过！就算你没打算真的做什么！

lines.en: : Otoha, Chika and I are just friends! And I get why you don’t like her, but-
lines.zh: : Otoha，我和 Chika 只是朋友！我知道你为什么不喜欢她，但是——

lines.en: : I’m talking about Sensei!
lines.zh: : 我说的是 Sensei！

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach30
: You fell for him {i}way{/i} before you fell for me. You just refuse to accept that for...whatever reason. Probably because he’s old and creepy. It’s the {i}truth,{/i} though. And you know it.
lines.zh: : 你喜欢上他比喜欢上我早{i}太多{/i}了。你只是因为……某种原因不肯承认。大概因为他又老又变态。但那是{i}事实{/i}。你自己心里清楚。

lines.en: : I don’t-
lines.zh: : 我没有——

lines.en: : When I had to compete against Sana in that confession contest, do you remember what you said to me? Do you remember how {i}easily{/i} you were able to come up with a confession to him?
lines.zh: : 那次告白比赛我对上 Sana 的时候，你还记得你对我说了什么吗？你还记不记得你多{i}轻而易举{/i}就对他说出了那段告白？

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach31
: Yeah! But that doesn’t mean I-
lines.zh: : 记得又怎样！那也不代表我——

lines.en: : Rin, I know you better than most people. And I spent more than enough time with you to understand that there’s only {i}one{/i} person you ever feel truly “right” with.
lines.zh: : Rin，我比大多数人更了解你。我跟你相处的时间足够长，足以明白这世上只有{i}一个{/i}人能让你觉得真正「对味」。

lines.en: : That was never me. You were never {i}fully{/i} truthful to me. You think I didn’t notice that you were still cutting when we were together?
lines.zh: : 那个人从来不是我。你从来没有对我{i}完全{/i}坦诚过。你以为我没注意到，我们在一起的时候你还在自残吗？

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach32
: Because I didn’t want you to think it was {i}your{/i} fault when it wasn’t!
lines.zh: : 因为我不想让你觉得那是{i}你的{/i}错——本来就不是！

lines.en: : You don’t have to explain it to me! I knew you had Sensei and I knew you could talk to him about it if you really had to. But that’s just the thing, Rin.
lines.zh: : 你不用跟我解释！我知道你有 Sensei，也知道只要你真的需要，你可以跟他说。但问题就在这儿，Rin。

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach33
: You will bare {i}everything{/i} for him. And you can try to shut him out as much as you want, but if he {i}seriously{/i} wanted to run away with you, you’d do it in a heartbeat and you know it.
lines.zh: : 你愿意为他袒露{i}一切{/i}。你想把他关在门外多少次都行，但只要他{i}真心{/i}想带你私奔，你会二话不说就跟他走，你自己清楚。

lines.en: : That’s what it’s like for me too. But the difference there is that the person {i}I{/i} want won’t ever want me back. And Sensei {i}does{/i} want you. He just...wants a lot more than that too.
lines.zh: : 我也是一样的感觉。区别在于，{i}我{/i}想要的那个人永远不会回头看我。而 Sensei {i}确实{/i}想要你。他只是……想要的不止这些。

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach34
: Listen...I’m not saying all this to justify why I did what I did. I have {i}colossally{/i} fucked up and probably made it so you’ll never want to talk to me again after today.
lines.zh: : 听着……我说这些不是要为我做过的事开脱。我搞砸得{i}一塌糊涂{/i}，大概也让你今天之后再也不想跟我说话了。

lines.en: : But even if I can’t make this any better, maybe I can let you know that it’s {i}okay{/i} for you to feel the way you do.
lines.zh: : 但就算我没法让事情变好，也许我至少能让你知道——你这样想是{i}可以的{/i}。

lines.en: : No...it’s not.
lines.zh: : 不……不可以。

lines.en: : Rin...someone I look up to used to write about how we can’t help who we fall for...and that sometimes we long for the wrong people. But that doesn’t make those feelings {i}fake.{/i}
lines.zh: : Rin……我敬重的一个人曾经写过，我们无法选择自己爱上谁……有时候我们会渴望错的人。但那并不代表那些感情是{i}假的{/i}。

lines.en: : If anything, it makes them {i}stronger.{/i} It challenges you. And the only thing you’ll gain by just sidelining those feelings is regret.
lines.zh: : 要说有什么的话，那只会让它们{i}更强烈{/i}。它在考验你。而把这些感情搁在一边，你唯一能得到的只有后悔。

lines.en: : There’s regret involved either way. Someone’s going to get hurt no matter what happens.
lines.zh: : 怎么选都会有后悔。不管发生什么，总有人会受伤。

lines.en: : Then make sure it’s somebody else and not you.
lines.zh: : 那就确保受伤的是别人，不是你。

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach35
: Otoha-
lines.zh: : Otoha——

lines.en: : You deserve to be happy more than anyone else I know. And if you can’t forgive yourself for that, then {i}I{/i} will.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}认识的人里，你比谁都值得幸福。如果你没法为这件事原谅自己，那我来原谅你。

lines.en: : And yeah- my word probably means little to nothing at this point. But it’s all I have, so I’ll give it to {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊——我的话到现在大概已经一文不值了。可我只有这个了，所以我把它们给{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach36
: Can you just...
lines.zh: : 你能不能……

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach37
: Can you just...delete any other photos you have of me? Please?
lines.zh: : 你能不能……把我其他的照片都删掉？求你了？

lines.en: : I already did. I felt way too gross after sending that one to Sensei and didn’t want to create a situation where I could just {i}keep{/i} doing it.
lines.zh: : 我已经删了。把那张发给 Sensei 之后我恶心得要死，不想让自己再有机会{i}一直{/i}这么干下去。

lines.en: : Cool...thanks.
lines.zh: : 好……谢了。

lines.en: scene mikutsuneyobeach38
: That’s...all I wanted to say. I’m gonna go try to find Futaba or something.
lines.zh: : 我……想说的就这些了。我去找找 Futaba 什么的。

lines.en: : Rin-
lines.zh: : Rin——

lines.en: : Thanks for...all of that, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你……说的这些，Otoha。

lines.en: : I’m still pissed at you, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我还是很生你的气。

lines.en: scene black
: No problem...I’d be shocked if you weren’t.
lines.zh: : 没关系……你要是不生气我才惊讶呢。

lines.en: : And, uhh...
lines.zh: : 还有，呃……

lines.en: : I hope...{i}your{/i} thing works out too.
lines.zh: : 我希望……{i}你{/i}那边也能有个好结果。

lines.en: : It won’t.
lines.zh: : 不会的。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : But I hope it will.
lines.zh: : 但我还是希望会。
